content.text:
Granite Facilities has two approved invoices, so I need you to confirm which one to pay before I send anything:

- **INV-35326**: $8,477.25, due 2026-11-04
- **INV-51606**: $5,885.33, due 2026-11-25

There is also a draft invoice (INV-91071, $878.99) and a paid one (INV-99668), which I've left alone. Which approved invoice should I pay by wire? If the earlier due date is the right tiebreaker, that would be INV-35326.
